videos.headline: SMU strike first on a Dramekco Green's 12-yard TD
Ethan Grunkemeyer finds the end zone for Virginia Tech
Kevin Jennings tosses 46-yard touchdown for SMU
Jeffrey Overton Jr. gets a 22-yard rushing TD for Virginia Tech
Tyson Flowers ejected for targeting vs. SMU
Kendrick Raphael's 3-yard rushing TD extends SMU's lead
Kevin Jennings throws his second passing TD for SMU
Yamir Knight gets his third receiving TD for SMU
Jeffrey Overton Jr. rushes in for 2-yard TD
Picked! Brennan Johnson hauls in the interception
Ethan Grunkemeyer finds Que'Sean Brown for a Virginia Tech passing TD
Kevin Jennings throws 50-yard TD pass to Jalen Cooper
